proves.claim: activityRuntime read() asks for events with after and limit and keeps asking until a page comes back short, covering a window longer than two batches.

view.activity.events-paged.why: The Activity page read its window with no limit, so a view worker built the whole event log in one StatementSync.all and crashed at 4.1 GB.

proves.claim: On a board of 10,000 items and 120,000 events the Activity page reads its window in bounded pages through the real API and the process peak heap stays under 1 GB.

view.activity.large-board-heap.why: The unbounded Activity read crashed the view worker at 4.1 GB on the live board; this measures the bounded read at the live board's scale.
